name: Sabae (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sabae city emblem in navy: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised pointed device.
history: Municipal flag of Sabae, a city in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1985; the emblem dates from 23 February 1955.

features.role: Sabae city emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a stylised pointed device
